WeeklyChart.title: WeeklyChart
WeeklyChart.description: Represents a weekly music chart generated by the application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the weekly chart.

startDate.description: The start date (Friday) of the weekly chart period.

endDate.description: The end date (Thursday) of the weekly chart period.

chartName.description: The name of the chart. This could be generated automatically or specified by the user.

ChartTrack.title: ChartTrack
ChartTrack.description: Represents a single track within a generated chart.

position.description: The position of the track in the chart (1-40).

playCount.description: The number of plays for the track during the chart period.

definition.description: Stores user's connected Last.fm accounts. Path-based ownership ensures only the user can access their own accounts.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The ID of the Last.fm account.

definition.description: Stores weekly music charts. Access is controlled by the ownerId field in the document.

params.name: weeklyChartId
params.description: The ID of the weekly chart.

firestore.reasoning: This design prioritizes security and scalability for the Chartify application. It leverages path-based ownership for user-specific data (LastfmAccount) and ownership-based access for collaborative charts. The design avoids complex subcollection rules by embedding the tracks array within the WeeklyChart document. This simplifies security rules and makes data retrieval more efficient for the client. Access to weekly charts is controlled by checking the `ownerId` field within the document, ensuring that only the creator of the chart can modify or delete it.
